- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Live Screen Test Stage: Adds a dedicated live desktop spawn test step after home intro where users trigger a test movement and confirm visibility on their actual screen. (why: Support receives multiple reports of pets not showing up on the desktop after onboarding, and the finish step has a drop to 77.7%.)
1: [home, new_flow] Interactive Render Waiting Experience Flow: Replaces static waiting with a interactive pet behavior preview carousel and background setup status tracker. (why: The waiting step has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), creating boredom and dropoff potential.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Notice on Sign-In: Displays an explicit account linking guarantee hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that existing pets will be preserved upon login. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest theme) report pets missing or getting reset after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, layout] Preset Archetype Audio & Visual Stage Layout: Changes the pick friend screen to a stage layout featuring live sound previews and companion reaction animations. (why: Adoption step drops to 72.3% and users take a median of 89s to pick their pet.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Diagnostics & Tray Guide: Adds desktop system tray and screen overlay status checks directly into the waiting screen status panel. (why: Support receives inquiries about pets failing to appear on the desktop and app failing to launch properly.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Account Migration Warning Notification on Sign-In: Adds an alert callout on the sign-in screen informing users how to merge guest pets into existing cloud profiles seamlessly. (why: Support receives 8 emails regarding pets getting reset or going missing after re-authenticating.)

scores.note: Live screen test addresses major finish step dropoff (22.3%) and support reports of pets failing to display on desktop.
Interactive flow reduces waiting friction at home step, though home step conversion is already high (93.0%).
Account sync hint directly addresses top support mail theme (8 emails), though sign-in drop is low (5.4%).
Rich audio/visual layout targets adoption step, which suffers from the largest drop in the funnel (27.7%).
Diagnostics panel provides immediate tray setup guidance addressing support emails regarding launch failures.
Migration warning callout tackles sign-in pet reset support issues via simple low-cost notification.
